# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_009_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 9

**9:1** And Joseph, throwing down his adze, went also to meet them. And when they were assembled, they went to the high priest, each one holding his staff. The high priest took the staffs from all of them, and he went into the temple and prayed. When he had finished his prayer, he took the staffs and went out and gave them back, and there was no sign among them.

**9:2** But Joseph received the last staff, and behold, a dove came out from the staff and flew onto Joseph's head. And the priest said to Joseph, "Joseph, you have been chosen by lot to receive the virgin of the Lord into your keeping."

**9:3** But Joseph refused, saying, "I have sons already, and I am an old man, and she is a young girl. I shall not be made a laughingstock among the children of Israel."

**9:4** And the priest said to Joseph, "Fear the Lord your God, and remember what God did to Dathan and Abiram and Korah, how the earth was split open and swallowed them up, because they resisted. And now fear lest the same happen to your house."

**9:5** And Joseph, being afraid, took her into his keeping and said to her, "Mary, I have received you from the temple of the Lord, and now I am leaving you in my house, and I am going away to build my buildings. Afterward I will come to you. The Lord will watch over you."
